Each of Z, X, C, V, B, N and M has an exam on a different day of a week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. Only B has an exam before Z. Z has an exam immediately before X. No one has an exam after V.  N has an exam on one of the days after M and on one of the days before C. How many people have exams after M?

E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding / subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only two people sit between D and B, when counted from the right of D. Only two people sit between B and G, when counted from the right of B. Only three people sit between D and E, when counted from the right of D. F sits to the immediate left of C. How many people sit between C and G when counted from the left of G?

Seven boxes, A, C, D, F, G, I and L, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only one box is kept below F. Only one box is kept above I. G is kept at one of the positions below F. Only C is kept immediately between F and A. Only one box is kept between C and L. How many boxes are kept between D and F?

Two sets of numbers are given below. In each set of numbers, certain mathematical operation(s) on the first number result(s) in the second number. Similarly, certain mathematical operation(s) on the second number result(s) in the third number and so on. Which of the given options follows the same set of operations as in the given sets?(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding to/subtracting from/multiplying with 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)85-120-155-190         ;       72-107-142-177

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements: All hens are bins.No bin is a candy.No bin is a rack.Conclusions:(I) No hen is a candy.(II) Some racks are candies.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Only conclusion (I) follows.) है।

In this question, two statements I and II have been given. These statements may be independent causes or effects of independent causes or a common cause. One of the statements maybe the effect of the other statement. Read both the statements and select the correct option.Statements:I. Deepti had been working extra shifts as a nurse in the hospital since last year and was very efficient with her work.II. Deepti is promoted as a head nurse in the hospital by the hospital manager last week.
options: Statement II is the cause and statement I is its possible effect.
Statement I is the cause and statement II is its possible effect.
Both statements I and II are effects of a common cause.
Both statements I and II are independent causes.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Statement I is the cause and statement II is its possible effect.) है।

questions.question:
अंग्रेजी वर्णमाला क्रम पर आधारित, निम्नलिखित चार अक्षर-समूह युग्मों में से तीन निश्चित तरीके से एकसमान हैं और इस प्रकार एक ग्रुप बनाते हैं। कौन-सा अक्षर-समूह युग्म उस ग्रुप से संबंधित नहीं है?

(नोट: असंगत अक्षर-समूह युग्म, व्यंजनों/स्वरों की संख्या या अक्षर-समूह में उनकी स्थिति पर आधारित नहीं है।)

इस प्रश्न में, एक कथन के बाद I और II से क्रमांकित दो कार्यवाहियां दी गई हैं। आपको कथन में दी गई सभी बातों को सत्य मानना होगा, तथा कथन में दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर यह तय करना होगा कि दी गई कार्यवाहियों में से कौन-सी कार्यवाही, कथन का तार्किक रूप से अनुसरण करती है।

कथन:
कुछ प्रमुख शहरों में क्रिसमस के दौरान लगभग 100 वर्षों में सबसे अधिक तापमान देखा जा सकता है, जबकि अन्य शहरों में क्रिसमस के लिए एक बिल्कुल नए रिकॉर्ड बुक की आवश्यकता हो सकती है। विशेषज्ञों के अनुसार, यह कुछ हद तक ग्लोबल वार्मिंग से संबंधित है।

कार्यवाहियां:
I. नागरिकों को ग्लोबल वार्मिंग से निपटने के उपायों का पालन करने की सलाह दी जानी चाहिए।
II. सौर ऊर्जा का उपयोग ऊर्जा के नवीकरणीय स्रोत के रूप में किया जाना चाहिए।
options: केवल कार्यवाही II अनुसरण करती है।
न तो कार्यवाही I और न ही कार्यवाही II अनुसरण करती है।
केवल कार्यवाही I अनुसरण करती है।
कार्यवाही I और II दोनों अनुसरण करती हैं।
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (कार्यवाही I और II दोनों अनुसरण करती हैं।) है।
